_comment: The scaffold's template catalogue — scale-and-adopt ticket 04.
Data, not code, because a template IS a workflow.json and a person who is
about to own one should be able to read it. `openstategraph/templates/` is
ordinary package data, so `pip install openstategraph` carries these files
and `openstategraph new --template routed-qa` works in an empty directory.
Order is the order `--list-templates` prints and the order the editor's
picker shows: cheapest first. `minimal` stays the default so a stranger's
first run costs one model call and cannot be rejected by a grader.
`{{name}}`, `{{slug}}` and any key under `defaults` are substituted into
every string of the template's workflow.json and AGENTS.md at scaffold
time. A template is a scaffold input: it produces a document and stops
existing. It is never a node type.

templates.name: minimal
templates.summary: input to agent to output — the smallest thing that runs (one model call).

templates.name: routed-qa
templates.summary: a router picks a branch, an agent answers, a grader sends weak answers back.

templates.name: team
templates.summary: supervisor plus worker plus grader — mountable as a Team node elsewhere.

defaults.outcome: - The answer must actually complete the task it was given.
